user.title: ZTE 5G Router
user.description: Connect your ZTE 5G / 4G router (e.g. G5TS, G5TC, G5C, G5 Max, G5 Ultra, MC801A, MC888).

data_description.host: Use the router's HTTPS origin, e.g. https://192.168.0.1. HTTP requires the explicit insecure HTTP option.
data_description.verify_tls: Verify the router certificate when using HTTPS. Disable only when you trust a self-signed certificate on your local network.
data_description.tls_fingerprint: For a self-signed certificate, enter its SHA-256 fingerprint verified from a trusted source. The exact certificate is then pinned; leave blank to use normal certificate validation.
data_description.allow_insecure_http: Required for HTTP. Router credentials and session traffic will be sent without encryption.
data_description.scan_interval: Default 60s. Refreshes signal metrics, serving cell parameters, data limits, and client lists.
data_description.fast_scan_interval: Default 5s. Refreshes real-time bandwidth throughput (download/upload) and CPU/RAM usage.
data_description.track_wifi_clients: Read-only WLAN and LAN device discovery during slow polling. New trackers are disabled by default until enabled in entity settings.
data_description.client_consider_home: Confirmed absence duration before reporting a client away (default: 180s).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ZTE router
reauth_confirm.description: The router rejected the stored password for "{name}". Enter the current WebUI administrator password.

error.invalid_scan_interval: The polling interval must be between 5 and 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_fast_scan_interval: The fast polling interval must be between 2 and 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid router origin using http:// or https://, without credentials, path, query, or fragment.
error.insecure_http: HTTP is unencrypted. Enable the explicit insecure HTTP option or use HTTPS.
error.invalid_tls_fingerprint: Enter a 64-character SHA-256 certificate fingerprint (colons are optional).
error.tls_fingerprint_requires_https: A TLS certificate fingerprint can only be used with an HTTPS router URL.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the ZTE router at this URL.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid router password or authentication rejected.

abort.already_configured: This ZTE router is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: ZTE 5G Router Options
init.description: Adjust polling intervals, credentials, and client tracking parameters.

data.password: New router password (leave blank to keep current)

data_description.allow_insecure_http: Required for HTTP. Router credentials and session traffic will be sent without encryption.
data_description.verify_tls: Verify the router certificate when using HTTPS. Disable only when you trust a self-signed certificate on your local network.
data_description.tls_fingerprint: Pin an out-of-band verified self-signed certificate fingerprint. Clear it to return to standard CA certificate validation.
data_description.track_wifi_clients: Read-only WLAN and LAN device discovery. Enable wanted devices under Settings > Devices & services > Entities.
data_description.client_consider_home: Grace period before marking a missing device as away (0-3600s).
